statuses.DEMONSTRATED: Demonstrated: passed a pre-declared test out of sample
statuses.INVALIDATED: Invalidated: tested with enough power, failed
statuses.NOT_SUPPORTED_UNDERPOWERED: Not supported, underpowered: no effect detected, a moderate effect is not excluded
statuses.NEVER_REALLY_TESTED: Never really tested: used or claimed without a valid test
statuses.NOT_EVALUABLE: Not evaluable: the data do not exist

register.signal: One account with almost no history supplies most of the buying that lifts a quiet low-priced outcome (LONELY_THIN ignition); does that outcome win more than its price says?
register.definition: 10-min price of one side: 6h baseline [t1-7h,t1-1h) >=18 points, median<=0.15, max<=0.20; x(t1)>=max(3*median, median+0.10); first BUY >=1.5*median opening a burst >=500 USD in 15 min; >=1,000 USD by alert; last buy<=0.90; initiator share15>=0.5 (LONELY) and prior_markets<=2 within last 500 activity rows (THIN); alert=max(t1,t_first+15min). Verdict code: SUPPORTED needs T1 and T2 < 0.05/18=0.0028 and excess>=0.15.
register.data: 34,413 Yes/No markets >=10k USD closed 2025-01..2026-10 (last 14 days of prices), 587 trade-confirmed ignitions: 570 VALIDATION (454 events), 17 DISCOVERY; class n=45, 44 events, 45 initiators; frozen 2026-11-14 01:03:19 UTC
register.result: 13 wins of 45 = 28.9% (95% 17.7-43.4) vs mean price 25.4%; excess +3.5 pts; T1 p=0.3346; cluster CI -9.8..+17.9; T2 diff +2.5 pts p=0.424 (n_other=525); leave-one-event-out excess -0.1..+5.2 pts, p 0.24-0.58; 0.47 alerts/week, 32/45 named the losing side; 13 winners: median ~23.5 h (1.3-212 h) from alert to price 0.95, 32 never reached it. Auditor recompute: T1 p=0.3346 reproduced; planted-excess power on the 45 real prices (T1 only = upper bound) 11% at +10 pts, 33% at +15, 61% at +20, 84% at +25, 96% at +30.
register.caveat: Power quoted for the exact test alone (11 % at +10 points, 33 % at +15, 84 % at +25); the verdict also required the second test, so the real power was lower. The second test permuted the class flag inside price bands.

open_questions.question: Does LONELY_THIN carry an excess of 15 points or less (or 25)? No test covers it: auditor power on the 45 real prices is 33% at +15 and 84% at +25 (T1 only); the blind audit says about 80 alerts give one chance in two at 15 points (BLIND_AUDIT.md:80).

Does the pattern behave differently in markets that close more than 14 days after the ignition, or with an end date anchored in advance? The sample is selected partly on the future (BLIND_AUDIT.md:18,76).
How robust is the alert price? 22 of 45 alerts use a last buy under 10 USD; a volume-weighted price or a 50 USD floor is untested (BLIND_AUDIT.md:20,77).

What are the precision and recall on informed accounts? No list of informed accounts exists (BACKTEST_RESULTS.md:86-90); false positives per day cannot be counted; market makers among the 362 LONELY alerts not measured.
Do funded groups of history-free accounts occur among ordinary traders outside alerts? 'Not measured' (PATTERN_RESEARCH.md:132); only 1 positive case exists for S07.

Can accumulation that does not move price (largest Maduro position, built over three days in a deep market) be detected at all? No detector or test exists (PATTERN_RESEARCH.md:178-179; BACKTEST_RESULTS.md:45-47).
Is 60% of pre-announcement purchases in four linked groups unusual? No comparable-market graph was built (NEW_LEADS.md:62,64).
What do the 13 winning and 32 losing LONELY_THIN alerts contain? None investigated (PATTERN_RESEARCH.md:154-156).
How large is the real lead over first public information? A sourced first-public time exists for 3 cases and is approximate for 2 (BACKTEST_RESULTS.md:92-93; AUDIT_20261113.md:125 M11).

Does a multi-day live run keep up, and how many tokens pass the filter on a busy day once history exists? Not measured (LIVE_DETECTION.md:125-133). Why the size-filtered feed was 118.8 s late in run 1 but 3.9 s in run 2 is unexplained (LIVE_DETECTION.md:29-30).
Prospective PolySentinel alerts versus sourced public announcements: 275 observations, 41 dossiers captured, first public publication unknown for all (signal_validation results.md:87,93).

Does study_sync_v2 (outcome-independent key, trigger-row price, series clustering, matched-share floor) change the NOT_SUPPORTED reading? Plan frozen, no data run (global-forensics FINDINGS.md:93-97).
Does any order-book feature predict moves with a proper sample (>=8 prints per arm)? Only 10 labelled prints existed (PATTERNS.md:23-31).
Common control of accounts: no positive control of common ownership exists for any method (BW/FINDINGS.md:55-61).
Do the cash-out and exit-structure signals (shared recipients, iran-exit-rarity) discriminate? Plan frozen, only synthetic controls run (AUDIT_20261113.md:125).
Match-level sports, e-sports, price ladders, weather and counting markets were excluded from the frozen population; no evidence exists about them (PATTERN_RESEARCH.md:30-33).
